name: hub-test-preview-isolation
goal: Hub browser checks start their own preview on a dedicated test port, accept only a validated named port override, and refuse any server already there; the development port 5798 and all 19 browser cases stay as they are

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: packages/hub/playwright.config.ts at 4a92aed (sha 4c9ac137) fixed the browser suite on the development port 5798 with reuseExistingServer true, so a run adopts whatever answers there, another checkout or a stale build included. Expected: the suite starts its own preview on a dedicated port, takes only a validated HARNESS_HUB_TEST_PORT, and refuses a server already there; port 5798 and the 19 cases unchanged. Proof files: /Users/danielfugere/Documents/Codex/2026-10-10/develop-a-framework-that-is-built/work/harness-remote-mobile/hub-test-preview-isolation (SHA256SUMS).

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Generated test/test-preview-refusal.test.ts (sha 681cd18c), cd packages/hub && bunx vitest run test/test-preview-refusal.test.ts on the byte-identical original config: 3 failed, exit 1; the config ignores the named port, stays on 5798 and reads an invalid port without refusal (guard-RED-original-config.log). The test starts a browser run only after the config is seen to aim at its own synthetic server, so 5798 was never contacted. Throwaway HEAD export with the original aimed at the synthetic port (original-config-fixture.diff): 3 failed, a HeadlessChrome request reached the foreign server (guard-RED-original-fixture-reuse.log).

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: playwright.config.ts (sha 9575986c): port from HARNESS_HUB_TEST_PORT or 5795, whole number 1024-65535 or refused by name; command bun run dev --port <port>; reuseExistingServer false; baseURL the same url; no webServer env, so HARNESS_VERIFY and the rest are inherited. README: one paragraph. package.json, tests/e2e and product source untouched (git diff --quiet HEAD -- packages/hub/tests packages/hub/package.json). No registry unit owns these files: units index adds and updates nothing.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same test file (sha 681cd18c), same command on the repaired config: 3 passed, exit 0 (guard-GREEN.log, guard-GREEN-final-recheck.log). bun run check:hub exit 0: format, svelte-check 973 files 0 errors, lint, 93 files 426 unit tests, build, audit, then 19 browser tests passed on the owned preview (check-hub.log). Listener on 5795 during the run was vite of this checkout's packages/hub; 5798 had no listener, 5799 pid 57111 untouched, 5795 released (hub-e2e-preview-owner.txt). Specs unchanged: 19 cases, 140 expect calls. A later one-line directory-lookup edit of the test was withdrawn unproven (withdrawn-directory-lookup-edit.diff); the final file is the red file.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
Prove the guard rejects a configuration that reuses an existing server, in a throwaway copy; prove the repaired tree passes.
steps.evidence: Throwaway HEAD export with the repair and reuseExistingServer true (mutant-reuse-true.diff, sha 9e568e48): same test file fails 2 of 3, a HeadlessChrome request reached its foreign server (guard-MUTANT-reuse-true.log). Repaired tree: 3 passed. Observed directly with bun run test:e2e: foreign page refused as already used with only the probe seen; a held port answering 404 stops Vite by strictPort; 5795x refused by name (refusal-*.log). Registry valid, 37 uncertain references: this test adds one, its package directory read as a url reference '..'; the node is seeded as uncertain, so selection is broader (registry-uncertain-reference.log).
